name: Crémant du Jura

rules.yield_base: 78 hl/ha with rows up to 1.6 m apart, 74 with rows 1.6 to 2 m apart
blend: For white wine, Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Trousseau together: at least 70%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
A white or rosé traditional-method sparkling wine from one of France's crémant appellations, made from hand-picked grapes and aged at least nine months on its lees.

blurb.text: A Jura appellation for quality sparkling wine made from Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, Pinot Gris, Poulsard, Trousseau and Savagnin Blanc. Jura is a cool-climate region between Burgundy and Switzerland, best known for vin jaune.
